name: Example notifier

does: Sends one short notice to each recipient who has confirmed they want it, through the fake channel port
does_not: Contact anyone who has not confirmed consent or who unsubscribed
Move money, sign or file anything, or impersonate a person
Bypass the outbound guard, the caps or a kill switch

charter.objective: Show the pack contract: a manager, a charter, a guarded loop and an outbound channel

primary_metric.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM guard_ledger WHERE pack = 'example' AND decision = 'sent' AND at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

guard_metrics.read_probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM guard_ledger WHERE pack = 'example' AND decision = 'refused' AND at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

enable_gate: Turn on the Example notifier? It will send one short notice a day to people who confirmed they want it, through the fake channel. It will not contact anyone else, move money, sign anything or bypass the caps. It costs nothing. Turn it off any time with one action.
